summary: Generation Income Properties disclosed a June 16, 2026 reacquisition of 100% of GIPDC 3707 14th St. LLC, owner of a Washington, D.C. 7-Eleven net-lease property, from preferred equity holder Brown Family Enterprises, which had received the interests under a March 3, 2026 agreement; the Company paid $600,000 cash and terminated the original agreement with mutual releases, resuming consolidation, and the Valley National Bank mortgage remained with the entity. Separately, it confirmed the July 15, 2026 $2,475,000 sale of its Vacaville, California property leased to the United States, and an August 21, 2026 Fresenius property sale in Chicago. Watch for further asset-sale pricing, deleveraging, and any preferred-holder disputes.
